## Checks

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest` passes
- [ ] A mapper change comes with a fixture and a test that covers it
- [ ] A data change says which corpus, which edition, and how it was verified (`python3 -m usfl verify`)
- [ ] No source text, database or archive is committed (they belong in `source/` and `dist/`)
